package.description: A companion application for Supernote devices that manages synchronized notes and documents and enables keyboard sharing.

en-US.description: A companion application for Supernote devices that manages synchronized notes and documents and enables keyboard sharing.
en-US.longDescription: Supernote Partner is a companion application for Supernote devices. This desktop application allows you to manage synchronized notes and documents, and offers features like keyboard sharing — pair your Supernote device, enable keyboard sharing, create a Word document on your device, and conveniently type on your PC's keyboard.
en-US.name: Supernote Partner

zh-CN.description: Supernote 设备的桌面伴侣应用，用于管理同步笔记与文档，并支持键盘共享。
zh-CN.longDescription: Supernote Partner 是 Supernote 设备的桌面伴侣应用。这款桌面应用可以管理同步的笔记与文档，并提供键盘共享等实用功能：将 Supernote 设备配对后开启键盘共享，在设备上新建 Word 文档，即可方便地使用电脑键盘输入。
